{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Edith Walks is a 2017 documentary film directed by Andrew Kötting which imagines a journey by Edith the Fair, wife of English king Harold Godwinson, from Waltham Abbey where he is buried to near the site of the Battle of Hastings and the invasion of England by William the Conqueror in 1066.","title":"Edith Walks"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It includes contributions from the writers Alan Moore and Iain Sinclair, the torch singer Claudia Barton, and the musician Jem Finer.","title":"Edith Walks"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Last English King (1997) is a historical novel by English writer Julian Rathbone.","title":"The Last English King"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The novel covers the time of the Battle of Hastings.","title":"The Last English King"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" It revolves around Walt Edwinson, a housecarl of Harold Godwinson, the last Anglo-Saxon king of England.","title":"The Last English King"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The story starts with Walt returning to his home at Iwerne in Dorset four years after the Battle of Hastings.","title":"The Last English King"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" He had fled England after the defeat of the Anglo-Saxons and had spent the time travelling across Europe and Asia Minor.","title":"The Last English King"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" The story of his journey from Constantinople via Nicomedia and Nicaea to Side is then recounted in parallel with his recollections of the time before the battle, such as his accompanying Harold to William of Normandy's attack on Dinan.","title":"The Last English King"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"In which county is the English king Harold Godwinson buried?"}
